en.t: Emperor Constantine the Great announces free distributions of food to the citizens in Constantinople
en.s: Constantine I (27 February 272 – 22 May 337), also known as Constantine the Great, was Roman emperor from AD 306 to 337 and the first Roman emperor to convert to Christianity. He played a pivotal role in elevating the status of Christianity in the Roman Empire, the Edict of Milan decriminalising Christian practice and ceasing Christian persecution. This was a turning point in the Christianisation of the Roman Empire.

zh.t: 君士坦丁大帝宣布向君士坦丁堡居民免费发放粮食
zh.s: 君士坦丁一世（272年2月27日—337年5月22日），又称君士坦丁大帝，公元306年至337年担任罗马皇帝，也是首位皈依基督教的罗马皇帝。他发挥了关键作用，使基督教在罗马帝国的地位提升。《米兰敕令》使基督教活动不再违法，并停止迫害基督徒，成为罗马帝国基督教化进程的转折点。

en.t: Louis II of Italy is crowned for the second time as Holy Roman Emperor at Rome, at the age of 47. His first coronation was 28 years earlier, in 844, during the reign of his father Lothair I
en.s: Louis II (825 – 12 August 875), sometimes called the Younger, was the king of Italy and emperor of the Carolingian Empire from 844, co-ruling with his father Lothair I until 855, after which he ruled alone. Louis's usual title was imperator augustus ("august emperor"), but he used imperator Romanorum ("emperor of the Romans") after his conquest of Bari in 871, which led to poor relations with the Eastern Roman Empire.

zh.t: 意大利国王路易二世在罗马第二次加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝，时年47岁
zh.s: 路易二世（825年—875年8月12日），又称小路易，自844年起担任意大利国王和加洛林帝国皇帝；他与父亲洛泰尔一世共同执政至855年，之后独自统治。他惯用“尊贵的皇帝”头衔，但871年征服巴里后改用“罗马人的皇帝”，使他与东罗马帝国的关系恶化。

en.t: Pope Benedict VIII begins his papacy following the death of his predecessor Pope Sergius IV earlier that month
en.s: Pope Benedict VIII (Latin: Benedictus VIII; c. 980 – 9 April 1024) was bishop of Rome and ruler of the Papal States from 18 May 1012 until 1024. He was born Theophylact of Tusculum to the noble family of the counts of Tusculum. Unusually for a medieval pope, he had strong authority both in Rome and abroad. Theophylact was born to Count Gregory I of Tusculum.

zh.t: 本笃八世开始担任教宗
zh.s: 本笃八世（拉丁语：Benedictus VIII；约980年—1024年4月9日）于1012年5月18日至1024年担任罗马主教和教皇国统治者。他本名特奥菲拉克特·迪·图斯库洛，出身于图斯库洛伯爵家族。与中世纪许多教宗不同，他在罗马及罗马以外地区都拥有强大权力。其父为图斯库洛伯爵格列高利一世。

en.s: The Worms massacre refers to the murder of 800 Jews of Worms, Germany, at the hands of crusaders headed by Count Emicho in May 1096. The massacre at Worms was one of number of attacks against Jewish communities perpetrated during the First Crusade (1096–1099). Followers of Count Emicho arrived at Worms on May 18, 1096. Soon after a rumour spread that the Jews had drowned a Christian and used contaminated water to poison the town’s wells. The local populace later joined forces with Emicho and launched a savage attack on the town’s Jews. Every Jew that was captured was slain.

zh.s: 沃尔姆斯大屠杀指1096年5月，埃米肖伯爵率领的十字军杀害德国沃尔姆斯约800名犹太人。这是第一次十字军东征（1096—1099年）期间针对犹太社群的多起袭击之一。1096年5月18日，埃米肖伯爵的追随者抵达沃尔姆斯。此后不久，谣言称犹太人淹死了一名基督徒，并用受污染的水毒害城中水井。当地居民后来加入埃米肖一方，对犹太人发动残暴袭击；所有被抓获的犹太人都遭杀害。

en.s: The Battle of Iconium (sometimes referred as the Battle of Konya) took place on May 18, 1190, during the Third Crusade, in the expedition of Frederick Barbarossa to the Holy Land. As a result, Iconium, the capital city of the Sultanate of Rûm under Kilij Arslan II, fell to the Imperial forces.

zh.s: 伊科尼翁战役有时也称科尼亚战役，于1190年5月18日爆发，是第三次十字军东征期间腓特烈·巴巴罗萨远征圣地的一部分。战斗后，罗姆苏丹国首都伊科尼翁（当时由基利杰阿尔斯兰二世统治）落入帝国军队之手。

en.s: The siege of Acre (also called the fall of Acre) took place in 1291 and resulted in the Crusaders' losing control of Acre to the Mamluk Sultanate of Egypt. It is considered one of the most important battles of the period. Although the crusading movement continued for several more centuries, the capture of the city marked the end of further crusades to the Levant.

zh.s: 阿卡围城战又称阿卡陷落，发生于1291年，十字军因此失去对阿卡的控制权，该城随后归马穆鲁克苏丹国统治。这场战役被认为是那个时期最重要的战役之一。十字军运动此后又持续了数个世纪，但阿卡陷落标志着十字军不再向黎凡特发动远征。

en.s: The Matins of Bruges (Dutch: Brugse Metten) was the nocturnal massacre of the French garrison in Bruges and their Leliaards supporters, a political faction in favour of French rule, on 18 May 1302 by the members of the local Flemish militia. It has been named "Matins" (after a monastic liturgy) in analogy to the Sicilian Vespers of 1282.

zh.s: 布鲁日晨祷事件（荷兰语：Brugse Metten）是当地佛兰德民兵于1302年5月18日夜间在布鲁日屠杀法国驻军及其支持者的事件。受害者包括支持法国统治的政治派别“莱利亚尔德派”成员。“晨祷”一名取自修道院礼仪，是仿照1282年的西西里晚祷事件而得名。

en.t: At the Battle of Buir Lake, a Ming Chinese army led by general Lan Yu defeated the forces of Tögüs Temür, the Mongol khan of Northern Yuan
en.s: The Battle of Buir Lake was fought between the Ming and Northern Yuan dynasties at the Buir Lake in 1388. The Ming army was led by General Lan Yu, who undertook the military campaign against the Northern Yuan horde led by Tögüs Temür. The Ming army defeated the Northern Yuan horde at the Buir Lake and captured many of their people.

zh.s: 1388年，明朝与北元王朝在布伊尔湖进行布伊尔湖战役。明军由蓝玉将军率领，出征对抗脱古思帖木儿率领的北元军队。明军在布伊尔湖击败北元军队，并俘获许多人。

en.s: The Battle of Brechin was fought on 18 May 1452 during the reign of James II of Scotland, about two and a half miles north north east of Brechin. By some interpretations, it was part of an on-off civil war during his reign between the king and an alliance of powerful noble families led by the Black Douglases, which as the king won was significant in the development of a relatively strong centralised monarchy in Scotland during the Late Middle Ages. A royalist army formed by the Clan Gordon and Clan Ogilvy, led by Alexander Gordon, 1st Earl of Huntly, defeated the rebel Alexander Lindsay, 4th Earl of Crawford, a leading ally of the Black Douglases.

zh.s: 布雷钦战役发生于1452年5月18日，苏格兰国王詹姆斯二世在位期间，地点在布雷钦以北东北方向约两英里半处。一些解释认为，这场战役是詹姆斯二世统治期间国王与以黑道格拉斯家族为首的强大贵族联盟之间反复爆发的内战的一部分。国王获胜后，苏格兰在中世纪晚期逐步建立起相对强大的中央集权君主制。第一代亨特利伯爵亚历山大·戈登率领戈登氏族和奥格威氏族组成的王党军队，击败了叛军领袖、第四代克劳福德伯爵亚历山大·林赛；林赛是黑道格拉斯家族的重要盟友。

en.s: The Second Battle of Oranik (Albanian: Beteja e Dytë e Oranikut) took place during the spring of 1456 in the plains of Oranik (Debar in modern-day Macedonia). Moisi Arianit Golemi, lord of Debar, and one of Skanderbeg's officers, deserted to the Ottomans following the defeat at Berat in 1455. Golemi set off from Adrianople with an army to capture Albania but was swiftly defeated by Skanderbeg's smaller forces.

zh.s: 第二次奥拉尼克战役（阿尔巴尼亚语：Beteja e Dytë e Oranikut）于1456年春发生在奥拉尼克平原（今北马其顿的代巴尔）。代巴尔领主、斯坎德培麾下军官莫伊西·阿里阿尼特·戈莱米在1455年贝拉特战役失利后叛投奥斯曼帝国。他从阿德里安堡率军出发，意图夺取阿尔巴尼亚，但很快被斯坎德培人数较少的部队击败。

en.t: The Great Siege of Malta begins, in which Ottoman forces attempt and fail to conquer Malta
en.s: The Great Siege of Malta (Maltese: L-Assedju l-Kbir) occurred in 1565 when the Ottoman Empire attempted to conquer the island of Malta, then held by the Knights Hospitaller. The siege lasted nearly four months, from 18 May to 8 September 1565. The Knights Hospitaller had been headquartered in Malta since 1530, after being driven out of Rhodes, also by the Ottomans, in 1522, following the siege of Rhodes.

zh.s: 马耳他大围城战（马耳他语：L-Assedju l-Kbir）发生于1565年，奥斯曼帝国试图征服由医院骑士团控制的马耳他岛。围城战从1565年5月18日持续到9月8日，接近四个月。医院骑士团于1530年从罗得岛被奥斯曼人驱逐后，将总部设在马耳他。

en.s: The siege of Coruña, also known as the defence of Corunna, was a series of military encounters between the English Armada and the defenders of the fishermen's city of Coruña in Galicia that lasted for two weeks in May 1589. The siege was the first interaction between the English Armada, a retaliatory English expedition within the Anglo-Spanish war, and the Spanish troops, and set the tone for the rest of the campaign.

zh.s: 科鲁尼亚围城战又称科鲁尼亚防卫战，是1589年5月英格兰舰队与加利西亚渔业城市科鲁尼亚守军之间的一系列军事交锋，持续两周。此战是英格兰远征舰队与西班牙军队在英西战争中的首次交锋，也影响了此后整个战役的走向。

en.s: The siege of Clonmel, from 27 April to 18 May 1650, took place during the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland, when Clonmel in County Tipperary was besieged by 8,000 men from the New Model Army under Oliver Cromwell. The garrison of 1,500 commanded by Hugh Dubh O'Neill eventually surrendered after inflicting heavy casualties on the besiegers.

zh.s: 克朗梅尔围城战于1650年4月27日至5月18日发生，是克伦威尔征服爱尔兰期间的一场战役。奥利弗·克伦威尔率领新模范军8,000人围攻蒂珀雷里郡的克朗梅尔。休·杜布·奥尼尔指挥的1,500名守军最终投降，但在此之前给围城者造成了重大伤亡。

en.s: The Battle of Skuodas happened during the Swedish Deluge on May 18, 1658 near Skuodas, the Hussar Captain Samuel Komorowski fought an unresolved battle against the army of Field Marshal Robert Douglas, who was forced to resign from the attack on Samogitia.

zh.s: 斯库奥达斯战役发生于1658年5月18日，是瑞典洪水时期的一场战斗。骠骑兵上尉萨穆埃尔·科莫罗夫斯基与罗伯特·道格拉斯元帅率领的军队交战，战斗没有分出胜负，道格拉斯被迫放弃进攻萨莫吉希亚。

en.s: The 1695 Linfen earthquake struck Shanxi Province in North China, Qing dynasty on May 18. Occurring at a shallow depth within the continental crust, the surface-wave magnitude 7.8 earthquake had a maximum intensity of XI on the China seismic intensity scale and Mercalli intensity scale. This devastating earthquake affected over 120 counties across eight provinces of modern-day China.
en.n: The 1695 Linfen earthquake in Shannxi, Qing dynasty causes extreme damage and kills at least 52,000 people.

zh.s: 1695年5月18日，清朝时期中国北方的山西省发生临汾地震。地震震源较浅，位于大陆地壳内，面波震级为7.8级，按中国地震烈度表和麦加利烈度表计算的最高烈度均为XI级。此次强震波及今天中国八个省份的120多个县。
zh.n: 1695年临汾地震发生于清朝山西，造成严重破坏，至少52,000人死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Andros or Battle of Kafireas was fought on 17–18 May 1790, during the Russo-Turkish War of 1787–1792, between Cape Kafireas and the island of Andros, between the ships of Lambros Katsonis, a Greek privateer in Imperial Russian service, and an Algerian fleet of 30–32 vessels. The battle was a major victory for the Ottomans, as Katsonis lost five ships and his flotilla ceased to exist as an operational unit.

zh.s: 安德罗斯战役又称卡菲雷阿斯战役，于1790年5月17日至18日在卡菲雷阿斯角与安德罗斯岛之间爆发，是1787—1792年俄土战争的一部分。交战双方是效力于俄罗斯帝国的希腊私掠船船长兰布罗斯·卡措尼斯所率舰队，以及由30至32艘船组成的阿尔及利亚舰队。奥斯曼一方大获全胜，卡措尼斯损失五艘船，其舰队也不再具备作战能力。

en.s: The Battle of Tourcoing (18 May 1794) saw a Republican French army directed by Joseph Souham defend against an attack by a Coalition army under Prince Josias of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld. The French army was temporarily led by Souham in the absence of its normal commander Jean-Charles Pichegru. Threatened with encirclement, Souham and division commanders Jean Victor Marie Moreau and Jacques Philippe Bonnaud improvised a counterattack which defeated the Coalition's widely separated and badly coordinated columns. The War of the First Coalition action was fought near the town of Tourcoing, just north of Lille in northeastern France.

zh.s: 图尔宽战役发生于1794年5月18日。约瑟夫·苏阿姆指挥的法兰西共和军抵御约西亚斯·冯·萨克森-科堡-萨尔费尔德亲王率领的反法同盟军进攻。由于原任指挥官让-夏尔·皮舍格吕不在，法军暂由苏阿姆指挥。面对被包围的危险，苏阿姆和师级指挥官让·维克多·莫罗、雅克·菲利普·博诺临时组织反击，击败了分散且协调不力的同盟军纵队。这场第一次反法同盟战争中的战役发生在法国东北部图尔宽附近，地点在里尔以北不远处。

en.s: The Treaty of Amiens (French: la paix d'Amiens, lit. 'the peace of Amiens') temporarily ended hostilities between France, the Spanish Empire, and the United Kingdom at the end of the War of the Second Coalition. It marked the end of the French Revolutionary Wars; after a short peace it set the stage for the Napoleonic Wars. Britain gave up most of its recent conquests; France was to evacuate Naples and Egypt.
en.n: Napoleonic Wars: The United Kingdom revokes the Treaty of Amiens and declares war on France.

zh.s: 《亚眠条约》（法语：la paix d'Amiens，意为“亚眠和平”）暂时结束了法国、西班牙帝国和英国之间的敌对状态，也标志着法国大革命战争的结束。短暂的和平之后，欧洲局势再次走向拿破仑战争。英国放弃了近期征服的大部分领土，法国则承诺撤出那不勒斯和埃及。
zh.n: 拿破仑战争：英国废除《亚眠条约》，并对法国宣战。

en.s: Napoleon Bonaparte (born Napoleone di Buonaparte; 15 August 1769 – 5 May 1821), later known by his regnal name Napoleon I, was Emperor of the French from 18 May 1804 until his first abdication in 1814, with a brief restoration during the Hundred Days in 1815. He rose to prominence as a general during the French Revolution and led a series of military campaigns across Europe and the Middle East during the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 拿破仑·波拿巴（原名拿破仑·迪·波拿巴，1769年8月15日—1821年5月5日）后来以拿破仑一世的帝号为人所知。他于1804年5月18日至1814年首次退位期间担任法兰西皇帝，并在1815年百日王朝期间短暂复辟。法国大革命期间，他作为将军崭露头角，随后在法国大革命战争和拿破仑战争期间率军在欧洲和中东多地作战。

en.s: The Battle of Mobekk was fought on 18 May 1808 between Swedish and Norwegian forces, during the Swedish invasion of Norway. After the Swedish victory at Lier, Bernhard Ditlef von Staffeldt ordered Johan Georg Ræder to attack the right flank of Gustaf Mauritz Armfelt's brigade, along the Skinnarbøl river.

zh.s: 莫贝克战役于1808年5月18日爆发，交战双方是瑞典军队和挪威军队，属于瑞典入侵挪威的一部分。瑞典军队在利耶尔战役取胜后，伯恩哈德·迪特莱夫·冯·施塔费尔特命令约翰·格奥尔格·雷德沿斯金纳尔博尔河攻击古斯塔夫·毛里茨·阿姆费尔特旅的右翼。

en.s: John Bellingham (c. 1769 – 18 May 1812) was an English merchant and perpetrator of the 1812 murder of Spencer Perceval, the only British prime minister to be assassinated.

en.s: The Liberal Wars (Portuguese: Guerras Liberais), also known as the Portuguese Civil War (Guerra Civil Portuguesa) and the War of the Two Brothers (Guerra dos Dois Irmãos) was a civil war in Portugal that lasted from May 1828 to May 1834, fought between liberal progressive constitutionalists (led by former King Pedro IV) and conservative traditionalists (led by King Miguel I) over the country's system of government and royal succession.

zh.s: 自由战争（葡萄牙语：Guerras Liberais）又称葡萄牙内战（Guerra Civil Portuguesa）或两兄弟战争（Guerra dos Dois Irmãos），是1828年5月至1834年5月在葡萄牙爆发的一场内战。战争双方是由前国王佩德罗四世领导的自由派进步立宪主义者，以及由国王米格尔一世领导的保守派传统主义者；双方围绕葡萄牙的政体和王位继承问题交战。

en.s: The Battle of Barranca Seca was a battle of the French intervention in Mexico and took place right after the Battle of Puebla on 18 May 1862. Contrary to the latter it was won by the unified reactionist Mexican-French forces. The battle was preceded by a coup de chef of the reactionist forces, which was heated by the intrigue of the Spanish high command against Almonte and Márquez and French pressure towards the replacement of Zuloaga. After the battle Almonte remained the only contender for the Commander-in-Chief office within the reactionist party and Márquez as acting General; both of them serving French interests.

zh.s: 巴兰卡塞卡战役发生于 1862 年 5 月 18 日，是法国干涉墨西哥期间的一场战斗，紧接在普埃布拉战役之后。与后者不同，这场战斗由墨西哥反动派与法国组成的联合部队获胜。战前，反动派内部发生了一场政变，西班牙高级指挥部对阿尔蒙特和马尔克斯的争斗，以及法国方面要求更换苏洛阿加，推动了事态发展。战后，阿尔蒙特仍是反动派唯一的总司令职位竞争者，马尔克斯则担任代理将军；两人都为法国利益效力。

en.s: The Battle of Yellow Bayou took place on May 18, 1864 in Avoyelles Parish, Louisiana between Union and Confederate forces. After learning of Confederate forces in Yellow Bayou, Brig. Gen. Joseph A. Mower was ordered to halt their advance. Union forces subsequently attacked the Confederates and drove them back to their main line. The Confederates then counter-attacked, forcing the Union forces to retreat, until they eventually repulsed the Confederate attack. This “see-saw” action lasted a few hours, until the ground cover caught fire and both sides were forced to retreat.

zh.s: 黄河口湾战役于1864年5月18日在路易斯安那州阿沃耶尔堂区爆发，交战双方是联邦军和南方邦联军。联邦军获悉黄河口湾有南方邦联军后，奉命停止推进。随后联邦军发动进攻，将对方赶回主阵地。南方邦联军反击，迫使联邦军撤退，之后联邦军又击退了这次反攻。双方几个小时内你来我往，直到地面植被起火，两军才被迫撤退。

en.s: The Warren Wagon Train raid, also known as the Salt Creek massacre, occurred on May 18, 1871. Henry Warren was contracted to haul supplies to forts in the west of Texas, including Fort Richardson, Fort Griffin, and Fort Concho. Traveling down the Jacksboro-Belknap road heading towards Salt Creek Crossing, they encountered William Tecumseh Sherman. Less than an hour after encountering the famous General, they spotted a rather large group of riders ahead. They quickly realized that these were Native American warriors, probably Kiowa and/or Comanche. The corn train quickly shifted into a ring formation, and all the mules were put into the center of the ring.

zh.s: 1871年5月18日，沃伦货车队遭袭，又称盐溪惨案。亨利·沃伦受雇为西得克萨斯的几座要塞运送补给，包括理查森堡、格里芬堡和康乔堡。车队沿杰克斯伯勒—贝尔纳普道路前往盐溪渡口时遇到威廉·特库姆塞·谢尔曼。不到一小时后，他们发现前方有一大群骑手；很快认出那是原住民战士，可能来自基奥瓦人或科曼奇人。车队迅速围成一圈，把骡子赶到圈内。

en.s: Plessy v. Ferguson, 163 U.S. 537 (1896), was a landmark United States Supreme Court decision ruling that racial segregation laws did not violate the U.S. Constitution as long as the facilities for each race were equal in quality, a doctrine that came to be known as "separate but equal". The decision legitimized the many "Jim Crow laws" re-establishing racial segregation that had been passed in the American South after the end of the Reconstruction era in 1877.

zh.s: 普莱西诉弗格森案（163 U.S. 537，1896年）是美国最高法院的一项里程碑式判决。法院裁定，只要不同种族使用的设施在质量上相同，种族隔离法律就不违反美国宪法。这一原则后来被称为“隔离但平等”。该判决认可了美国南方在1877年重建时期结束后通过的许多吉姆·克劳法，使种族隔离制度重新确立。

The election was the first one in which women had a right to vote. The election was the first held since Premier William Kidston, formerly of the Labour Party, had founded a new movement with his own supporters as well as the Parliamentary Conservatives.

en.s: The Bath School disaster, sometimes known as the Bath School massacre, was a series of violent attacks perpetrated by Andrew Kehoe on May 18, 1927, in Bath Township, Michigan, that killed 38 elementary schoolchildren and 6 adults and injured at least 58 other people. Kehoe killed his wife and firebombed his farm, then detonated an explosion in the Bath Consolidated School, before committing suicide by detonating a final device in his truck. It is the deadliest mass murder to take place at a school in United States history. Andrew Kehoe, the 55-year-old school board treasurer, was angered by increased taxes and his defeat in the Spring 1926 election for township clerk.

zh.s: 巴斯镇学校惨案有时也称巴斯镇学校大屠杀，是安德鲁·基霍于1927年5月18日在密歇根州巴斯镇发动的一系列暴力袭击，造成38名小学生和6名成年人死亡，至少58人受伤。基霍杀害妻子并纵火焚烧自家农场，随后在巴斯联合学校引爆炸弹，最后又在自己的卡车上引爆装置自杀。这是美国历史上发生在学校的最致命大规模谋杀事件。55岁的基霍是学校董事会财务主管，因税额上升以及在1926年春季选举中竞选镇书记员失败而愤怒。

The original Chinese Theatre was commissioned following the success of the nearby Grauman's Egyptian Theatre, which opened in 1922. Both were built as Exotic Revival style architecture.

zh.s: 格劳曼中国剧院（现因赞助而以 TCL 中国剧院为官方名称，通常简称“中国剧院”）是一座电影宫殿，位于美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶好莱坞星光大道。附近的格劳曼埃及剧院于 1922 年开业，原中国剧院的建造计划是在其成功后提出的。两座剧院均采用异国复兴式建筑风格。

en.s: The Battle of Muong Khoua took place between April 13 and May 18, 1953, in northern Laos during the French Indochina War. A garrison of a dozen French and 300 Laotian troops occupied a fortified outpost in the hills above the village of Muong Khoua, across the border from Điện Biên Phủ. Muong Khoua was among the last French outposts in northern Laos following the decision of the French High Command to string several isolated garrisons through the region in order to buy time to fortify the major Laotian cities against Việt Minh attack.

zh.s: 芒库阿战役于1953年4月13日至5月18日在老挝北部爆发，是法属印度支那战争的一部分。法军有十余人、老挝军队有300人，驻守在芒库阿村上方山丘上的一处设防据点，该村位于奠边府边境对面。法国最高统帅部决定在这一地区设立数个孤立据点，以争取时间加固老挝主要城市、防备越盟进攻；芒库阿是此后老挝北部最后一批法军据点之一。

en.s: Apollo 10 was the fourth manned mission in the United States Apollo space program, and the second (after Apollo 8) to orbit the Moon. Launched on May 18, 1969, it was the F mission: a "dress rehearsal" for the first Moon landing, testing all of the components and procedures, just short of actually landing. The Lunar Module (LM) followed a descent orbit to within 8.4 nautical miles (15.6 km) of the lunar surface, at the point where powered descent for landing would normally begin. Its success enabled the first landing to be attempted on the Apollo 11 mission two months later.

en.s: Elections for local government were held in Northern Ireland in May 1977. 526 councillors were elected. The elections saw good performances by the four largest parties: the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP), Social Democratic and Labour Party (SDLP), Alliance Party of Northern Ireland and Democratic Unionist Party (DUP), while smaller parties failed to make a breakthrough. The DUP took control of their first council, Ballymena, while the UUP retained control of Banbridge.

zh.s: 北爱尔兰于1977年5月举行地方政府选举，共选出526名议员。四个最大政党——阿尔斯特统一党（UUP）、社会民主工党（SDLP）、北爱尔兰联盟党和民主统一党（DUP）表现不错，小党则未能取得突破。民主统一党首次控制一个地方议会，即巴利米纳区议会；阿尔斯特统一党则继续控制班布里奇区议会。

en.s: Presidential Elections were held in Austria on 18 May 1980. The incumbent president, Rudolf Kirchschläger, was re-elected by a landslide of 79.9% of the votes, being supported by both major Austrian Parties: the ruling Socialist Party of Austria and the opposition Austrian People's Party. The competing candidates were Wilfried Gredler of the Freedom Party of Austria and Norbert Burger of the later prohibited National Democratic Party.

en.s: On May 18, 1980, at 8:32 a.m., Mount St. Helens in Skamania County, Washington, United States, experienced a catastrophic explosive eruption which had a volcanic explosivity index of 5. It was the first to occur in the contiguous United States since the much smaller 1915 eruption of Lassen Peak in California. The main eruption was preceded by a series of volcanic explosions, pyroclastic flows, and phreatic blasts beginning in March 1980.

zh.s: 1980年5月18日上午8时32分，美国华盛顿州斯卡梅尼亚县的圣海伦火山发生灾难性爆炸式喷发，火山爆发指数为5。这是美国本土48州自1915年加利福尼亚州拉森峰规模小得多的喷发以来，首次发生火山喷发。主喷发之前，自1980年3月起已出现一系列火山爆炸、火山碎屑流和蒸汽爆炸。

en.s: The Sri Lankan civil war was fought in Sri Lanka from 1983 to 2009. Beginning on 23 July 1983, it was an intermittent insurgency against the government by the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE, also known as the Tamil Tigers) led by Velupillai Prabhakaran. The LTTE fought to create an independent Tamil state called Tamil Eelam in the north-east of the island in response to continuous discrimination and violent persecution against Sri Lankan Tamils by the predominantly Sinhalese government of Sri Lanka.

en.t: United States Senate Democratic primary election in Pennsylvania, 2010
en.s: The Democratic primary for the 2010 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania took place on May 18, 2010, when Congressman Joe Sestak defeated incumbent Arlen Specter, which led to the end of Specter's five-term Senatorial career. Just prior to the start of the primary campaign, after serving in the Senate as a Republican for 29 years, Specter had switched to the Democratic Party in anticipation of a difficult primary challenge by Pat Toomey; Sestak was ultimately defeated by Toomey in the general election. Political observers and journalists described the race between Specter and Sestak as one of the bitterest and most watched of all the 2010 primary elections.

en.s: Municipal elections were held in South Africa on 18 May 2011, electing new councils for all municipalities in the country. Half of the seats (rounded up for odd numbers) in each municipality are elected on the first past the post system in single member wards. The other half of the seats are allocated to restore proportionality as follows: The total number of seats are allocated using the largest remainder method by using a modified Hare quota.

en.s: The 2023 Danish Cup final was played on 18 May 2023 between AaB and Copenhagen at Parken, Copenhagen. en.t: 2026 Islamic Center of San Diego shooting
en.s: On May 18, 2026, a shooting occurred at the Islamic Center of San Diego (ICSD), the largest mosque in San Diego, California, United States. Two gunmen, 17-year-old Cain Lee Clark and 18-year-old Caleb Liam Vazquez, fatally shot a security guard and two community members outside the mosque before fleeing. Subsequently, they shot at a landscaper in a drive-by shooting and committed suicide in a nearby neighborhood.
